data.description:
## Incident Overview

**Component:** dso:code-reviewer-light agent (and potentially other reviewer agents)
**Condition:** Agent produces REVIEWER_HASH output with fewer than 64 hex characters
**Observed result:** record-review.sh reports 'hash mismatch' and exits 1

## Evidence

Reviewer agent prompt (paraphrased):
'Review the staged changes in the repository. Run git diff --cached. Three changes: write-reviewer-findings.sh normalization + two markdown shim-exempt comments. Write reviewer-findings.json to /tmp/workflow-plugin-fedc6b1ad4ed2334/reviewer-findings.json.'

Agent output (as returned):
REVIEW_RESULT: passed
REVIEWER_HASH=e7818922350dd7d59e1a068986b72bf0cadea3d86c0e2a3c4a99107
MIN_SCORE=4
FINDING_COUNT=1
FILES: plugins/dso/scripts/write-reviewer-findings.sh

Actual SHA256 of reviewer-findings.json at time of recording:
e7818922350dd7d59e1a068986b72db0c3b712bf0cadea3d86c0e2a3c4a99107

The REVIEWER_HASH emitted by the agent was 56 hex chars, missing 8 chars in the middle vs the actual 64-char SHA256. The mismatch caused record-review.sh to fail with 'reviewer-findings.json hash mismatch'.

## Impact
Blocks commits from completing when a reviewer emits a truncated hash. Requires manual intervention to re-run the review or use the actual file hash.

## Hypotheses
1. LLM output truncation — the agent computed the correct hash but truncated its output when including it in the structured REVIEW_RESULT block
2. Wrong hash computation — the agent used a non-SHA256 algorithm or truncated the input
3. Context window pressure — the response was cut off due to token limits
data.title: [dso:code-reviewer-light]: Review agent emits truncated REVIEWER_HASH (56 chars instead of 64) -> record-review.sh rejects with hash mismatch
